items.title: Triage current gap_analyze high gaps
items.context: Run gap_analyze and classify the two signed workspace gaps as real consistency/coverage candidates, while classifying Layer4 customerKeyRef as future/blocked scope unless actual Layer4 implementation is started.
items.userSees: Completion report states: current gap_analyze high gaps were triaged; signed workspace gaps require real consistency verification; Layer4 customerKeyRef is future/blocked.

happy.desc: gap_analyze is rerun and the three high findings are classified without claiming they are resolved.

edge.desc: If customerKeyRef is future capability prose, the plan marks it future/blocked instead of starting implementation.

adversarial.desc: The triage must not mark F-009 resolved or Layer2/Layer4 unlocked without formal proof.

items.title: Draft a conservative execution document
items.context: Use Claude CLI and Codex CLI as independent host draft/review inputs. The document must include Lattice CLI flow, two-host audit protocol, no false closure, and exact DONE criteria.
items.userSees: Completion report links the new execution document and says it is an execution plan only, not an unlock artifact.

happy.desc: New document contains purpose, Lattice CLI flow, two-host protocol, exact steps, stop conditions, and DONE criteria.

edge.desc: Document handles dirty main and unrelated docs by keeping story work isolated and avoiding unrelated edits.

adversarial.desc: Document forbids false closure, arbitrary optimization, and local host verdicts becoming Authority proof.

items.title: Mark future Layer4 customerKeyRef scope explicitly
items.context: If customerKeyRef is only documented as future capability, adjust the relevant document wording so gap handling is future/blocked rather than implied current implementation.
items.userSees: Completion report says Layer4 customerKeyRef is explicitly future/blocked unless a separate Layer4 implementation story is opened.

happy.desc: Layer4 document states customerKeyRef is future/blocked planning scope in this context.

edge.desc: Wording still preserves future Layer4 execution requirements and does not delete the planned production safety concept.

adversarial.desc: Wording must not imply current CLI support or verified Authority receipt for customerKeyRef.

items.title: Verify documentation consistency and navigation
items.context: Run the relevant docs/navigation checks available in this repo and record evidence; do not touch unrelated dirty documentation.
items.userSees: Completion report lists verification commands and says docs/navigation consistency passed or identifies the remaining blocker.

happy.desc: NAV includes the new document with the correct count and relative link.

edge.desc: Existing unrelated dirty documentation is not included in this story diff.

adversarial.desc: Final validation must not pass if the document says PASS or UNLOCKED for claims this story did not prove.
